verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kimi Code agents that read and edit files and run terminal commands inside a local project folder. That is a coding-agent capability, adjacent to but not the same as letting the assistant see and operate desktop applications. Nothing in the pack documents screen perception or app control, and the browser-extension and agent-mode entries are bare help-page titles with no such detail.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
